method.beforeState: Shared clone of the baseline inside TMPDIR with its own copy of modules/ui-web/node_modules; no stash or revert.
method.runnerS: Vitest JSON startTime to the last file endTime, including the build in beforeAll.
method.alone: No load created by this session; other sessions on the 20-CPU machine kept a load average of about 5-14 throughout, so alone runs are not idle-machine runs.
method.load: Suite pinned with taskset to 4 CPUs, two python busy loops pinned to two of them, started and killed by PID by the same script; baseline on CPUs 0-3 (busy 0, 1) and candidate on CPUs 4-7 (busy 4, 5), run at the same time; identical for before and after.
method.resources: Owned headless Chromium, loopback vite preview servers on port 0 and two CPU-load processes on this machine. No shared dev stack, owner app or CI.

equivalence.what: Every measured value of the legibility cases dumped (temporary instrumentation in shared clones only), with the time of each measurement and a per-frame record of the root tokens, the palette stylesheet and the mounted surface, keyed by case and surface/forced/control/state.
equivalence.mechanism: Engine recovery mounts with the default tokens; the app keeps booting behind it and restoreAppearanceOnBoot then injects the saved palette (style[data-theme-id=<palette>]) 31-119 ms after the mount (36 pages observed). No animations ran (document.getAnimations() empty on all 10512 measured rows) and the hover/active/focus-visible state matched the intended state on every row. Neither tree waited for the palette: the candidate measured from about 50 ms after the mount, the baseline from about 40-160 ms, so both raced the restore. The other eleven surfaces showed no token change after any measurement on either tree.

baselineUnwaited.example: core.registrars-ledger dark, Minimize icon and focus ring measured 42 and 49 ms after the mount, palette applied at 68 ms: icon 10.837 (default dark tokens) where the settled paint is 9.322.
baselineUnwaited.differingFromSettled: run 2: 3 values (core.nord dark Minimize icon and focus ring, core.night-registry light Minimize icon)

equivalence.settledCondition: Engine recovery measured once style[data-theme-id=<palette>] is attached (the condition both hand-offs already waited on). The candidate test waits for it; for the comparison the baseline clone got the same one wait (diagnostic only, not part of this change).
equivalence.note: Candidate before this fix against the unwaited baseline: 22 differing values in one run, all on engine recovery with the candidate on default tokens; an independent check had seen 33.

plantedDefects.how: BOOT_FRAME_TREE pointed at a shared clone of the baseline with one rule added to index.html; candidate test file (with the engine-recovery wait); the 12 legibility cases run.

A-normal.rule: #window-controls button:active { color: var(--window-control-fill); } (after the hover/active rule, outside forced colours)
A-normal.expected: 12 surfaces x 3 controls x the two pressed states

B-forced.expected: 12 surfaces x 3 controls x the three ring states

sa6.unchanged: Byte-identical in both trees and runs before any changed code (the first changed line is 1099; the case is at line 307; the only module-level additions are constants).
sa6.result: Not reproduced on either tree; the candidate changes nothing it executes.
